# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. The score is low for two reasons. `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay out of the whole site, and the pages are built in the visitor's browser, so crawlers that skip JavaScript get an empty page. The one unknown is the canonical link, because no site domain is declared anywhere. Every result here was read from code, not measured on a running site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop `robots.txt` blocking the whole site - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` asks every crawler, including Google, Bing and AI search bots, not to read any page. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59. This fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014. If blocking was intentional, for example a staging site, check that before changing it. ### 2. Put the page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** Many crawlers don't run JavaScript. They see an empty `
`, and the Catalogue list only loads after the page opens in a browser. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` - **What the code says:** `
` and `fetch('/api/mugs')` inside `useEffect` - **Size:** Large (prerender or server-render the routes, or use an SSR framework). - **Score after this (on its own):** 37–46 ### 3. Give the site a real title, description and language - **Why it matters:** Right now every page is titled "Vite App", has no description and doesn't declare its language. - **Where:** `index.html:2` and `index.html:5` - **What the code says:** `` and `Vite App` - **Size:** Small (a single-page app shares one head, so per-page titles also need a head helper). - **Score after this (on its own):** 33–41. This is GEO-012 only. Adding a sitemap (GEO-011) is a separate 2 points. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is readable and valid | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed as intended | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` blocks `*` site-wide (assumed you want to be found) | | GEO-014 | Routes can be indexed | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2`; both routes blocked for Googlebot and Bingbot. No `noindex` found. | | GEO-015 | Canonical link | Can't tell | Not run | No canonical and no declared domain | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Problem | Not run | `index.html:8`; 2 of 2 routes | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD in the repo | | GEO-011 | Sitemap | Problem | Not run | No sitemap and no `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | Not run | `index.html:2` has no `lang`, `index.html:5` has the generic title, and there is no description | | GEO-016 | Links reachable by crawlers | Problem | Not run | `src/main.jsx:11`; Catalogue is reached only via a button | | GEO-017 | No snippet blocking | Clear | Not run | No `nosnippet` or `max-snippet` found | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Problem | Not run | `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`; Home has an image with no `alt`, Catalogue is fine (1 of 2 routes) | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | ## Other problems found - **Catalogue data only exists after a browser fetch:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6`: `fetch('/api/mugs')`. Render the list on the server or at build time so crawlers see the mugs. ## Worth considering - **Describe the hero image:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`: ``. Add `alt` text so the picture's content is available as text. - **Give each mug its own page:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `{items.map((m) =>

{m.name}

)}`. Mugs are shown only as names. Individual pages with links would give each mug an address, and Product structured data could label price and details, if you show them. - **Say more about what you sell:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: `Thrown by hand in Bristol and shipped worldwide.` Visitors would likely ask about price, sizes and shipping, and the site doesn't answer those in text. - **Declare your site's domain:** no domain appears anywhere in the code, which blocks canonical links and a sitemap. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** I need your production domain. Once you give it, this can be checked. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Server headers:** `X-Robots-Tag` or redirects set by your host are outside the repo. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. If `Disallow: /` is deliberate, items 1 and the GEO-009/014 results change. - Only two routes exist, `/` and `/catalogue`, and both were checked. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-003`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
